# ChannelScale

ChannelScale turns client-provided footage into 60 unique clips per month, with selection, editing, approvals, publishing on 4+ agreed client-owned platforms and performance review.

- Offer: https://channelscale.yt/offer
- Work and dated evidence: https://channelscale.yt/work
- About: https://channelscale.yt/about
- Inquiries: https://channelscale.yt/apply

Pricing is custom after source review. A paid pilot can be scoped before an ongoing engagement. Results are examples, not guarantees. Filming, full episodes and independent creator campaigns require a separate scope.
